procedures.name: General Dental Consultation & Checkup
procedures.description: Comprehensive intraoral evaluation by senior dentists with digital X-ray and personalized treatment roadmap.

procedures.name: Dental Implants
procedures.warranty: Lifetime Warranty on Swiss Straumann / Nobel Biocare Implants
procedures.description: Permanent titanium tooth root replacement with computer-guided placement. Includes 3D CBCT imaging and custom zirconia crown.

procedures.name: Invisalign Clear Aligners
procedures.warranty: 5-Year Guarantee with free tray refinements & Vivera retainers
procedures.description: US-FDA approved transparent removable aligners for discreet teeth straightening without metal wires.

procedures.name: Traditional Metal & Ceramic Braces
procedures.description: High-precision orthodontic brackets (metal or tooth-colored ceramic) for complex alignment corrections.

procedures.name: Teeth Cleaning & Ultrasonic Scaling
procedures.description: Painless ultrasonic scaling and air-polishing to remove plaque, calculus stains, and prevent gum disease.

procedures.name: Composite Tooth Filling & Cavity Restoration
procedures.description: Tooth-colored composite restoration to repair decay, fractures, and gaps with natural aesthetics.

procedures.name: Tooth Extraction & Wisdom Teeth Surgery
procedures.description: Painless surgical and painless extractions including impacted 3rd molar wisdom teeth under local anesthesia.

procedures.name: Single-Visit Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
procedures.description: Painless rotary endodontic root canal completed in a single 60-minute visit, preserving natural teeth.

procedures.name: Professional Laser Teeth Whitening
procedures.description: In-office LED laser teeth whitening system brightening smiles up to 8 shades in under 45 minutes.

procedures.name: Full Mouth Rehabilitation & All-on-4 Implants
procedures.description: Complete jaw restoration using 4 or 6 dental implants supporting fixed hybrid prosthetic bridge.

faqs.answer: Apex Dental Center is located on 100 Feet Road, Koramangala 4th Block, Bengaluru, right near the Sony World Signal. We have free dedicated valet parking for all patients!
Yes! We offer free dedicated valet parking right in front of our Koramangala clinic for all visiting patients.
Our Koramangala clinic is open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM (Emergency & Prior Appointments).
We offer 0% interest EMI payment plans via Bajaj Finserv and major credit cards for treatments over ₹15,000, with monthly installments starting at ₹2,500/month.
We support cashless dental insurance claims for select corporate networks and provide itemized clinical bills & tax receipts for all major health insurance reimbursements.
Our initial specialist consultation fee is ₹500, which includes a comprehensive intraoral examination, digital X-ray review, and personalized 3D treatment planning.
